summary: A well-scoped, mathematically clean 4-page companion verification artifact (TAPE-INT-MULT-CERT-1.0) presenting 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems and a zero-floating-point Python verifier over Z, Q, and F_p across 16 canonical certificates (C01-C16) auditing finite-dimensional algebraic, CRT, Benes, Bluestein chirp, Newton/Brent, sunflower #SAT, and Euclidean wire-price building blocks of OpenAI's unrefereed preprint [8]. All identities and worked numerical witnesses visible in the PDF check out exactly, and the manuscript maintains an honest scope boundary. Its main limitations are that Proposition 1 (Verifier Soundness) is asserted without proof, some parameter side conditions and Mode 3a/4b definitions are omitted from the concise PDF text, and the core asymptotic arguments of [8] lie outside scope.
weaknesses: Proposition 1 is presented as a mathematical proposition without proof; verifier correctness is supported only by self-reported AST checks and 50 adversarial forgery tests rather than formal verification.

Lean compilation, pytest execution, and external repository artifacts cannot be independently verified from the PDF alone, and some Mode 3a/4b definitions needed for full self-contained reproduction are omitted from the 4-page text.
The scientific contribution is bounded to finite-dimensional algebraic and combinatorial checks of elementary building blocks rather than validating the asymptotic complexity bounds of [8].
